name: Pitwall Underground Fighter's Full Fight Kit
description: Minimal and brutal — a sleeveless compression vest in abrasion-resistant matte black with aug-mount cutouts for chrome arms, paired with reinforced fight shorts in deep indigo with a flex-waistband rated for tail and hip augmentation, and bare-knuckle grip wraps in dirty white tape over fingerless compression gloves. A hooded warm-up jacket in worn gray fleece with a single heat-sealed sponsor tag (partially burned off) hangs over the shoulders before the fight. The whole kit smells like adrenaline and concrete.
functionality: Aug-mount cutouts accommodate full chrome arm ranges of motion; flex waistband accommodates tail and hip geneware; grip tape provides bare-knuckle protection to fighters without chrome hands.
what_it_says: This person gets paid to hurt people in basements, and they're good at it.
manufacturer: Pitwall House Gear (unlicensed fight circuit brand)
story_hooks: The burned-off sponsor tag is from a corponation that's been pressuring the fighter to throw a match — the burn was a message back.
The fight shorts contain a hidden pocket with a data chip the fighter agreed to carry across the city without knowing what's on it.

physical_description.visual_profile: Raw, stripped-down fighter's silhouette — muscular frame displayed with minimal coverage, built for kinetic efficiency. The look is intentionally brutal and street-coded: someone who lives in underground fight circuits, not corpo gyms. Aesthetic reads as deliberate poverty mixed with hard-won respect.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tight through the torso and limbs; the vest clings like a second skin. Shorts sit low on the hips with a deep cut for mobility and aug accommodation. Everything is tailored for maximum range of motion, zero excess fabric.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte-finish ballistic weave (abrasion-resistant synthetic). Compression fabric throughout. Gray fleece on the jacket (cheap, worn stock). Fingerless gloves in moisture-wicking synth-leather. Wraps in crude white athletic tape (reused, stained).
physical_description.texture: Vest surface is smooth but grainy, with a subtle sheen from repeated sweat and impact. Tape wraps are rough, slightly frayed at the edges. Fleece is soft but pilled from heavy use. Gloves show creasing and darkened stains around the knuckles.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black vest as the core. Deep indigo shorts. Dirty white tape wraps with dark sweat rings. Gray fleece jacket faded to near-white at stress points. Single sponsor tag remnant (scorched, unreadable).
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit compression on the vest (no closures). Flex-waistband shorts with magnetic snap at the fly. Gloves laced tight with tape. Jacket held casually over shoulders, hood down.
distinctive_features: Chrome aug-mount cutouts on the vest shoulders — cleanly machined, exposing the skin beneath
Reinforced stitching along the shorts' side seams, rated for appendage stress
Bare-knuckle grip wraps wrapped over fingerless gloves in a stacked technique
Sponsor tag on jacket partially burned or laser-scorched (indicates illegal fight history or arena damage)
Multiple small tears in the fleece, sealed but visible
Sweat stains darkening the fabric at the armpits and inner thighs
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 (sub-grade/ungoverned). This is salvage-and-street-market gear, illegal fight circuit exclusive. No corp branding, no warranty, no legitimacy.
physical_description.cultural_context: Underground fighter. Illegal augmentation infrastructure. Pitwall House loyalty (criminal sports syndicate). Wearing this signals: I fight for money I need, in places the law doesn't reach. Anti-corpo. Augmented (likely).  Dangerous.
physical_description.condition_typical: Weathered and patched. Fabric showing impact scarring, sweat saturation, small repairs. The tape wraps are dirty, sometimes re-wound mid-fight. Everything smells like concrete dust, adrenaline sweat, and cheap antiseptic.
